en: A colorized vintage postcard showing a large rectangular four-story building with many windows and a central loggia covered in abundant flowering vines, likely wisteria. In front of the building is a small courtyard or square with young trees and a smaller rounded chapel-like structure attached on the right. The sky is lightly tinted blue and orange, giving a hand-colored look. Italian text at the top identifies the scene as a gymnasium (secondary school) near a bishop's residence in Trento and mentions a gigantic Chinese wisteria.
